purpose: The Notification Service sends notifications via email and SMS based on domain events and provides an API for manual sends and template management.

components.name: Notifier
components.evidence: The notifier consumes domain events from domain-events (Kafka), renders messages from templates and sends them through the Email and SMS provider.

components.name: Template Manager
components.evidence: PUT /v1/templates/{templateId} creates or replaces a template with a subject and a body.
